as_of_content:
The '''Jazz Relics''' are rewarded for mastering the [[Missing Beats]] Spotlight Missions.

== Description ==
''A groovy symbol of one Autobot's faith in his teammates. Awarded for mastery of the [[Jazz]] Special Missions.''

== Relic Boosts ==
* (Tier 1): +1% Health in Alliance Missions
* Bronze: +2%
* Silver: +3%
* Gold: +6%
